exposure: 4H Scotland intervention (monthly home visits, motivational interviewing, SMS support for healthy energy balance related behaviours including sleep duration, physical activity, screen time, family meals)
outcome: Objective and subjective measures of energy balance related behaviours (EBRBs)
Feasibility and acceptability of study design components
Appropriateness and practicality of obtaining outcome measures
cohort: Up to 40 families with preschool children residing in a community in Dundee, Scotland, experiencing health/social inequalities and high levels of deprivation.
finding: This protocol outlines a feasibility study to adapt and implement the North American Healthy Habits, Happy Homes (4H) preschool childhood obesity prevention intervention for Scottish families, assessing its feasibility and acceptability to inform future definitive trials or routine practice.
